specialist_latest_commit.message: worker-c: Deterministic handling of same-clock conflicting same-record revisions

candidate.name: Canaan Inc. August 2026 bitcoin mining, treasury monetization and ADS buyback, SEC Form 6-K
candidate.primary_reproduction: Read SEC index accession and acceptance 2026-09-14 09:15:04 ET; read exhibit 99.1 paragraphs 'Management Commentary', 'August 2026 Bitcoin Mining Updates', footnote 1, and 'Recent Corporate Updates'.

source_facts.notes: Treasury balance includes receivables and excludes customer deposits; JV mining metrics separately stated and excluded from reported bitcoin production.

criteria.first_party_machine_readable: PASS: issuer-signed SEC 6-K Exhibit 99.1 HTML accessible, with parsable reported figures
criteria.immutable_report_identity: PASS: SEC accession 0001104659-26-107320 and accession-specific exhibit path
criteria.economic_entity_scope: PARTIAL: issuer treasury and reported non-JV mining defined; 49% JV operations separate, custody/receivables not transaction-attributed
criteria.effective_clock: PARTIAL: month-end stock 2026-08-31, August production and late-August sale window; no individual BTC/ETH trade timestamps
criteria.available_clock: PASS for conservative SEC publication anchor 2026-09-14 09:15:04 ET (acceptance); earlier press release time not assumed as verified ingestion
criteria.observed_clock: RESEARCH_ONLY 2026-10-11 09:30 ICT; no actual historical collector observation timestamp established
criteria.non_overlap: FAIL: 54 BTC and 3952 ETH sales lack execution IDs, exchange venue or trade timestamps, cannot be distinguished from existing market volume; 44 mined and 1868 treasury stock are different economic concepts and not additive capital inflow
criteria.context_only: REQUIRED: 1868 BTC balance and mined inventory are nondirectional custody/production context, not independent purchase signal

candidate.rejection: First-party immutable filing confirms Canaan monetized 54 BTC and 3952 ETH and reported 44 BTC production and 1868 BTC stock, but exact trade IDs/times, observed-at PIT collection clock and non-overlap are absent. Cash proceeds funded ADS repurchases, not demonstrable new Bitcoin capital. Holdings include receivables and are context_only. Do not count the sale separately from existing market-volume observations or count mining/treasury as fresh directional flow.
